subject: Finalizing renewal true-up & invoice split for GreenCloud — action needed
messages:
From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@greencloud.co.uk>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: GreenCloud Finance <finance@greencloud.co.uk>
Date: 2026-08-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal true-up + invoice split request

Hi Markus,

We’re working through the renewal true-up for our Redwood subscription and I wanted to confirm the final invoice details before routing to finance. A couple of asks from our side:

- Can Redwood split the final amount into two invoices to charge two internal cost centers (engineering vs. platform)? We need separate invoice numbers for our AP process.
- Please include a VAT breakdown per invoice (we’re VAT-registered in the UK and need the VAT ID on the invoice).
- Provide a PO number field — we will supply PO GC-7782.

Also, we may need a short statement on the invoice mentioning reverse-charge treatment if applicable.

Can you confirm whether you can produce two invoices (total equals the true-up) and what additional info you need from us? I’ve CC’d our finance inbox for visibility.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Patel
Head of Cloud Ops
GreenCloud Ltd.

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@greencloud.co.uk>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal true-up + invoice split request

Hi Sara — thanks for the clear note. We can split the final true-up into two invoices. I’ve attached a draft breakdown and a provisional invoice ID for review (RI_Draft_Invoice_4521.xlsx).

Quick answers:
- We can issue two invoices that sum to the agreed true-up.
- We will include VAT line items and your supplied VAT ID on each invoice once you confirm it.
- PO GC-7782 will be added to both invoice headers as requested.
- If reverse-charge applies, indicate your VAT registration and we’ll add a note per EU invoicing requirements.

Priya — can finance confirm the proper account code to use for the split and whether we should generate separate payment terms for each invoice?

Sara — can you send the VAT ID and confirm the two internal cost center names as they should appear on the invoices?

Best,
Markus
Markus Klein
Account Executive, Renewals
Redwood Inference

Attachment: RI_Draft_Invoice_4521.xlsx (spreadsheet — draft line items)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T09:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal true-up + invoice split request

Markus — leaving a note from finance:

- Splitting is fine. We should create two invoice numbers for tracking (e.g., 4521 and 4522) and reference a single umbrella PO if the customer prefers.
- Default payment terms: Net 30 on both. If finance requests different terms per cost center, we can accommodate but need explicit confirmation from GreenCloud.
- For VAT: if GreenCloud is VAT-registered (GB VAT ID), Redwood will show VAT on the invoice unless they request reverse-charge wording. For reverse-charge we need the VAT ID and confirmation that they are the recipient for reverse charge; we’ll include the legal string: ‘reverse charge — VAT to be accounted for by the recipient’.
- Credits: Markus, check whether there are any credits/overpayments from the prior term to offset; if yes, note them on the first invoice.

Jordan — please prepare the two invoice numbers and a final PDF we can send to the customer. Include a short line for PO: GC-7782 and space for the VAT ID.

Thanks,
Priya
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@greencloud.co.uk>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: GreenCloud Finance <finance@greencloud.co.uk>
Date: 2026-08-04T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal true-up + invoice split request

Thanks — VAT ID is GB999888777. Please split invoices as:

- Invoice A (Engineering cost center): £28,560.00 (incl VAT)
- Invoice B (Platform cost center): £14,280.00 (incl VAT)

Total: £42,840.00 (incl VAT).

PO: GC-7782 (attached). Please send the final invoices to finance@greencloud.co.uk.

Also: can you include our internal cost center codes on each invoice (ENG-22 and PLAT-09)? These are required for our AP system.

If you need our WHT exemption certificate for any withholding tax checks, let me know — I can ask AP to send it.

Attachment: GreenCloud_PO_GC-7782.pdf (PDF — purchase order)

—Sara

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@greencloud.co.uk>, GreenCloud Finance <finance@greencloud.co.uk>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-05T14:15:00-07:00
Subject: Final invoices and DocuSign for SOW addendum

Hi Sara — thanks for the details. Attached are the two finalized invoices and a DocuSign link for the minor SOW addendum that covers the true-up scope. Invoice details below:

- Invoice 4521 (ENG-22): £28,560.00 — VAT 20% shown (net £23,800.00, VAT £4,760.00)
- Invoice 4522 (PLAT-09): £14,280.00 — VAT 20% shown (net £11,900.00, VAT £2,380.00)

We included PO GC-7782 on both invoices and added your cost center codes. If you prefer reverse-charge wording instead of VAT lines, let us know and we’ll reissue.

DocuSign: https://docusign.example/sign/abc123 (SOW addendum — minor scope adjustment to reflect true-up)
HubSpot: https://hubspot.example/contacts/GC-4521

Attachments: RI_Final_Invoice_4521.pdf, RI_Final_Invoice_4522.pdf

Please confirm receipt and, if everything looks good, sign the addendum so we can send invoices to our AR queue for processing. Payment terms: Net 30 from date of invoice.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Billing Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: GreenCloud Finance <finance@greencloud.co.uk>, Sara Patel <sara.patel@greencloud.co.uk>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-06T17:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Final invoices and DocuSign for SOW addendum

Hi Sara / GreenCloud Finance —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Once we receive the signed DocuSign addendum (link above) we will mark invoices for AR processing and email the PDF invoices to finance@greencloud.co.uk as requested. If GreenCloud will be using reverse-charge, please confirm in writing and we will reissue with the legal text; otherwise these show VAT as standard.

Also, please confirm whether GreenCloud will provide a WHT exemption certificate (if applicable) so we can note tax treatment in our records.

I’ll follow up with a payment instructions email to finance after the addendum is signed.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Accounting Lead, Redwood Inference
